name: meofast-monorepo
description: Meetofast — Open-Source, 100% Free, Self-Hosted Web API Development Platform

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@meofast/shared && npx concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev --workspace=@meofast/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@meofast/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@meofast/shared && npm run build --workspace=@meofast/cli && npm run build --workspace=@meofast/api && npm run build --workspace=@meofast/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@meofast/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@meofast/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@meofast/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@meofast/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@meofast/shared && npm run test --workspace=@meofast/api
